name: Robo-Mechanical Guts
summary: In Stormwind, Shoni gathers parts from Gnomeregan’s roaming machines. She needs them to repair tunneling vehicles built to help reclaim the city in Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Salvage for the Fleet
sections.body:
After High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the surviving gnomes fled Gnomeregan, thousands of machines remained behind. Automated mechanisms, clockwork sentries, and industrial robots still roam the radioactive city’s corridors.

In Stormwind City, tinker Shoni is assembling gyrodrillmatic excavationators to break through Gnomeregan’s defenses and reclaim the lost city. She sends adventurers into the contaminated halls to salvage working parts from the robots, including springs, wires, and gyro-components.

faq.q: What are Robo-Mechanical Guts used for?
faq.answer: Shoni in Stormwind City gathers Robo-Mechanical Guts to repair gyrodrillmatic excavationators. These tunneling vehicles are meant to help reclaim Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Where do you find these components?
aliases: where to get robo mechanical guts
faq.answer: You can salvage these components from hostile clockwork automatons, mechs, and contaminated hostiles roaming Gnomeregan’s outskirts and depths.

faq.q: Who is Shoni and why does she need so many parts?
faq.answer: Shoni is a gnome engineer stationed in Stormwind’s Dwarven District. She needs parts to prepare nearly four hundred subterranean excavation machines to breach Gnomeregan’s occupied ruins.

angles.text: Each tangle of wiring and gyro-cog comes from gnomish automated designs. Radiation and isolation changed the machines, and now they roam.
As a gnome, salvaging the rogue clockwork sentries of your lost home can feel bittersweet. Their machinery provides parts to help reclaim Gnomeregan.
